question.problem:
Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[X].$ Give your answer to two decimal places.

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}, & 1<x<2 \\ \frac{2}{9}, & 2\le x<3\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x
$$

 

We compute the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{1}^{3}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}x\cdot \frac{{x}^{2}}{3}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot \frac{2}{9}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}\frac{2x}{9}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{{x}^{4}}{12}|}_{1}^{2}+{\frac{{x}^{2}}{9}|}_{2}^{3} \\  & =\frac{15}{12}+\frac{5}{9} \\  & =\frac{65}{36} \\  & ≈1.81,\end{aligned}
$$

 

rounded to two decimal places.
